data.name: Athanasios
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Αθανάσιος (Athanasios), derived from ἄθανασος (athanasos) meaning 'immortal' or 'one who is not subject to death'. This name was borne by several early Christian saints, including Athanasius of Alexandria (c. 296–373), who was a leading theologian and church father of the early Christian Church.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name carrying the promise of eternal life and divine protection.

in_hebrew.name: אתנאסיוס
in_hebrew.meaning: השם אתנאסיוס נגזר מיוונית, פירושו אלמוות, נצחי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אתנאסיוס מקורו ביוונית עתיקה, מורכב משני מילים: 'אטה' (αἰ) שמשמעותה 'לא' ו-'תנאטוס' (θνατός) שמשמעותו 'מוות'. המשמעות המילולית היא 'אלמוות' או 'נצחי'. השם קשור קשר הדוק לתאולוגיה הנוצרית, המדגישה את נצחיות הנפש ואת תחיית המתים. באספקט הרוחני, אתנאסיוס מייצג את האמונה באלמוות ובחיי נצח.

in_greek.name: Αθανάσιος
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Αθανάσιος σημαίνει αθάνατος, αέναος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αθανάσιος προέρχεται από την αρχαία ελληνική γλώσσα. Είναι σύνθετο από το 'α' (αἰ) που σημαίνει 'όχι' και το 'θνατός' (thanatos) που σημαίνει 'θάνατος'. Η κυριολεκτική σημασία είναι 'αθάνατος' ή 'αέναος'. Ο Άγιος Αθανάσιος ήταν εξέχων θεολόγος και επίσκοπος Αλεξανδρείας τον 4ο αιώνα, γνωστός για την υπεράσπισή του του δόγματος της Τριάδος και την συμμετοχή του στις αποφάσεις της Α' Οικουμενικής Συνόδου της Νικαίας. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την πίστη στην αθανασία της ψυχής και την αναστήσταση.

in_latin.name: Athanasios
in_latin.meaning: The name Athanasios means immortal, eternal
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Athanasios originates from ancient Greek. It is derived from 'a' (αἰ) meaning 'not' and 'thanatos' (θνατός) meaning 'death'. The literal meaning is 'immortal' or 'eternal'. In Christian tradition, Athanasios signifies faith in the immortality of the soul and the resurrection. The name gained prominence through Saint Athanasius, a pivotal theologian and bishop of Alexandria in the 4th century, renowned for his defense of the Trinity doctrine.

in_english.name: Athanasios
in_english.meaning: The name Athanasios means immortal or eternal
in_english.long_meaning: The name Athanasios is of Greek origin, derived from 'a' (not) and 'thanatos' (death), literally meaning 'immortal' or 'eternal'. It is deeply rooted in Christian theology, emphasizing the immortality of the soul and the resurrection. Historically, the name is associated with Saint Athanasius, a 4th-century theologian and bishop of Alexandria, who played a crucial role in the development of the Nicene Creed. The name symbolizes eternal life and spiritual endurance.

saint_reference.note: Bishop of Alexandria, key figure in the Arian controversy and the formulation of the Nicene Creed

data.cultural_impact: The name Athanasios enjoys a rich cultural heritage in the Greek Orthodox tradition, where it is a common given name. It is associated with the day of Saint Athanasius, which is celebrated on the 2nd of May. In Greece, it is customary to offer a special meal on this day, which often includes traditional dishes such as lamb or goat meat, vegetables, and local wines. This feast day is an occasion for families and communities to come together and honor the spiritual legacy of Saint Athanasius.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Athanasios holds profound spiritual significance for Christians, as it is a reminder of the promise of eternal life and the importance of living a virtuous life. It serves as a testament to the belief that, through faith in God, one can overcome the trials and tribulations of this earthly life and attain everlasting peace in the next. The sacrifice and dedication of the various saints named Athanasios, particularly Saint Athanasius of Alexandria, continue to inspire and guide believers in their own spiritual journeys.

historical_references.reference: Athanasios was a prominent bishop and theologian of the early Christian Church, best known for his defense of Trinitarian doctrine against the Arians.
